att_trigger.definition: The event that makes a person read a partner as less available than the person assumed.
att_trigger.example: One missed call was the trigger, and the rest of the evening went into reading the silence.

attention_economy.definition: The market in which businesses compete for people's limited attention and resell it to advertisers.

follow_up.definition: A message sent after an earlier one, either to remind someone or to ask for a decision.
follow_up.example: This is a short follow-up to my email of last Tuesday.

hungry.definition: The feeling you get when your body wants food and needs energy.
hungry.example: I am hungry, so I will have some bread.

sensor.definition: A small sense organ on a robot. It tells the robot what is around it, or how it feels.
sensor.example: Bit's sensor flashed red when he was worried.
